positive_snippets: Excellent stay! The rooms are hygienic and well-maintained. The staff's behavior is also very nice and welcoming. Overall, a great experience!

Had a great stay at Sukajini with my family last weekend. The place was clean, comfortable, and felt just like home. The staff were really nice and helpful throughout our stay. It’s a peaceful spot and everything we needed was easily available. We felt safe and well taken care of. Would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a nice, affordable place to stay with family.
